task_description: Create a complete fully rebrandable professional gym and fitness website with admin panel using PHP 8+, MySQL, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. No frameworks. Premium dark theme, mobile-first responsive design, SEO friendly, shared hosting compatible.

verification.summary: All 40 PHP files pass syntax validation (php -l). 46 total files created matching the required folder structure. Security verified: all admin pages have requireLogin(), all forms have CSRF protection, all SQL uses PDO prepared statements. CSS is 2487 lines, JS is 466 lines, database.sql has all 11 tables with default data.
